description:
• Brand introduction: 

Cerberus Collective is a lifestyle brand rooted in Calgary, known for its bold automotive-inspired apparel and custom vehicle giveaways. With a unique blend of automotive culture and tattoo artistry, Cerberus Collective appeals to enthusiasts of sports cars, muscle cars, lifted trucks, motorcycles, and the rugged, independent lifestyle they represent. 


• Product description:

 The product line includes high-quality apparel like t-shirts and hoodies, all designed to reflect the passions and aesthetics of car culture. The standout attraction is the exclusive opportunity for customers to enter giveaways of custom-built, one-of-a-kind vehicles with each purchase. 


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Exclusive Vehicle Giveaways: Every purchase grants customers entries to win custom-built vehicles, making each item more than just apparel but a chance to win a piece of automotive art.
  • Authentic Lifestyle Appeal: Products are crafted to resonate deeply with automotive and tattoo culture enthusiasts, creating a strong brand-community connection.
  • Security and Trust: The brand is transparent about avoiding scams, reassuring customers through official channels and clear communication.


• Payment terms:

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates earn a percentage of each sale generated through their referrals. (Specify details as needed)
  • Payment Frequency: Regular payouts, typically monthly, with a minimum threshold for payout. Payment methods include direct bank deposits or other convenient methods based on affiliate preference.

 • Other information:

  • Affiliate Support: Cerberus Collective provides affiliates with a range of marketing assets, including banners, product images, and exclusive content, to boost conversion rates.
  • Dedicated Affiliate Portal: Affiliates can track clicks, conversions, and payouts in real-time through a user-friendly dashboard.
  • Partnership Perks: Potential for higher commissions or bonus entries for top-performing affiliates, helping them further engage with the brand's fanbase.
